scenes.say: Stop starting your day with a plain bagel. It packs about fifty six grams of carbs.
scenes.headline: STOP EATING THIS FOR BREAKFAST

scenes.say: The mistake is carbs with almost no fiber. Swap it for a protein plate instead.
scenes.headline: BREAKFAST MISTAKE

scenes.say: Two eggs, half an avocado, tomato, and one slice of whole grain toast.
scenes.headline: BUILD THE PLATE

scenes.say: And here's the best part. It takes about five minutes. Cook the eggs, slice the rest, toast the bread.
scenes.headline: READY IN 5 MINUTES

scenes.say: Why it works: the bagel has just two grams of fiber. This plate has about nine, plus nineteen grams of protein.
scenes.headline: WHY IT WORKS
scenes.sub: Protein and fiber help keep you full

scenes.say: No time for eggs? Plain Greek yogurt with berries and a few nuts works too.
scenes.headline: NO EGGS? TRY THIS

scenes.say: Protein and fiber first, carbs on the side. Save this for tomorrow morning.
scenes.headline: PROTEIN FIRST, CARBS ON THE SIDE
